intro.title: Multi-Step Form
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a multi-step form that guides users through a sign-up process in separate, manageable sections. You'll learn how to manage form state and navigation between steps using Angular's reactive forms and component-based architecture. The main technologies involved are TypeScript for type safety, Angular components for structuring the UI, and RxJS Observables for handling state changes. By the end, you'll have a functional form that validates user input and progresses through multiple stages with clear visual feedback.
intro.usecase: Multi-step forms are essential in modern web applications where complex data collection needs to be broken into manageable sections. You'll find them in e-commerce checkout flows (like Amazon or Shopify), account creation wizards (such as LinkedIn or banking platforms), and insurance quote calculators. As an Angular developer, you'll implement these patterns to guide users through lengthy processes while maintaining clear progress indicators and validation at each stage. This approach improves user experience by reducing cognitive load and preventing form abandonment in real-world applications.
